payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various models explored in the paper, including traditional machine learning algorithms and newer models specifically designed for fake news detection.

claims.text: The paper explores various machine learning models including Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Feed-Forward Neural Network (FFNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Logistic Regression.
Newer models such as TraceMiner, which utilizes an LSTM-RNN architecture, and FAKEDETECTOR for credibility detection are also discussed.
The study evaluates models using pre-trained algorithms like TFIDF, CountVectorizer (CV), and Word2Vec (W2V) for text representation.
The paper mentions using Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and neural networks for classification tasks.
